content:

over the U.S. Army._

Happy Thursday, everybody. It's **Swin** again. As we've [been reporting for
months at](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/3_h2uRk3bjI) **Zeteo** , **Donald
Trump** and his Republican Party have been marshaling a gargantuan sum of YOUR
money - _[in the billions!](https://zeteo.com/p/donald-trump-pyongyang) _- for
initiatives designed to feed his vanity and perpetuate his cult of
personality. It's one of the more disturbing aspects of an infernally
authoritarian time, the kind of thing we lied about to ourselves for decades,
insisting it can't happen here. And yet the president and his gang of thieves
and reprobates are so clumsy that it's hard not to laugh at them, even as they
try to arrest you [for laughing at
them](https://bsky.app/profile/swin24.bsky.social/post/3mozskn5wv22r).

In today's '**First Draft** ,' we dive back into Trump and the GOP's bungled
Pyongyang-ification of our capital, and how it underscores the limits of his
reign of terror. Plus, Trump stokes more Capitol Hill chaos, and he stokes a
shouting match with a GOP senator, while shivving his own party over a
bipartisan housing bill.

On the night of June 17, I made a joke [on
Bluesky](https://bsky.app/profile/swin24.bsky.social/post/3mojo5ohdv22g) that
Donald Trump **" needs this war to end"** so he **" can stop worrying about
war on Iran and get back to his main priority of war on Reflecting Pool."**
Because the second Trump era defies all satire, an hour later, the Interior
Department began comparing efforts to combat **" the dead algae"** plaguing
the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool [to Trump's war on
Iran](https://x.com/interiorpress47/status/2067436655523369239).

The Reflecting Pool saga, now escalated to the White House imposing a [mini-
police-state](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/jun/23/reflecting-pool-
arrest-washington-dc) around the pool while accused of [killing
ducks](https://biologicaldiversity.org/w/news/press-releases/investigation-
urged-after-ducks-found-dead-at-trumps-reflecting-pool-2026-06-23/), is
nothing if not emblematic of the Maddest-Emperor phase of Trump's [Mad Emperor
presidency](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-one-year-america-first-mad-king). He and
several departments are siphoning a ton of public money, time, and resources
into a vanity project. Now the project is over-budget and [devolving
into](https://www.pbs.org/newshour/politics/the-reflecting-pool-is-about-to-
be-drained-again-heres-what-to-know) a mortifying self-inflicted spectacle,
the president is having armed agents - and [literal U.S.
troops](https://apnews.com/article/reflecting-pool-trump-algae-
coating-a41bbf59575f221d28e70452d0757f78) - patrol the area. Trump is bragging
about how many people have been [arrested or
cited](https://apnews.com/article/reflecting-pool-trump-algae-coating-park-
police-d2ebb174e98913435d2108d60fb8de44) for disrespecting his pool, and much
of the U.S. government is spreading Trump's lie that "vandals" caused the
damage that his own "renovation" has in fact wrought. The president is also
threatening to sue media outlets that [piss him off about the
pool](https://www.forbes.com/sites/siladityaray/2026/06/23/trump-threatens-to-
sue-abc-news-alleging-false-reporting-about-reflecting-pool/). And in keeping
with the broader traditions of the Trump-Vance administration, they can't even
manage to pull off this small disaster without seeming [suspiciously
corrupt](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/06/18/us/politics/trump-donor-contract-
reflecting-pool.html).

The Trump presidency is full of perfect metaphors for the depravity and self-
defeating failures of the ruling party's policies. For instance, Trump's
military birthday parade in DC last year was a visual representation of the
[blundering limitations of](https://www.rollingstone.com/politics/politics-
features/trump-military-birthday-parade-dc-failure-1235365040/) his fascist
personality cult, and another sign that his administration can't do anything
big or small without doing it **"[
illegally](https://www.rollingstone.com/politics/politics-features/trump-
military-birthday-parade-song-bobby-scott-illegal-1235374520/)."** Now Trump's
hyper-fixation on the reflecting pool - including his expensive, boneheaded
inability to fix it and his demands for a cover-up of yet another humiliation
- stands tall among painfully on-the-nose metaphors for the horror he and his
party are causing and the wars they're losing.
